name: [HALLOWEEN] Lacko's Slap Battles
desc:
A game about slapping people with different gloves with unique ability's
You can unlock gloves with slaps or badges. Slaps can be earned by slapping (obviously) or by winning a tournament
Credits to DM Doku and Desolo Zantas for Killstreak and Reaper songs. Game originated from Slap Battles, play it here: https://www.roblox.com/games/6403373529 Make sure to like the game for more updates, and follow to notice when an update releases. There are 93 gloves currently in the game. (Witch Update)

!Premium Users Will Get The Premium Glove!

Supported Devices: Mobile, PC, Console
